rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to refer to someone who is driving a motor vehicle, without implying driving is their job.

example.english: A motorist shouldn't look at their phone while driving.
example.traditional: 揸車嘅人，揸車嗰陣唔好睇手機。
example.jyutping: zaa1 ce1 ge3 jan4 zaa1 ce1 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 tai2 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this when referring to the driver of a vehicle, especially when the person is acting as a professional driver or the vehicle has a designated driver.

example.english: The motorist we hired will pick us up at the hotel entrance.
example.traditional: 我哋請咗個司機，佢會喺酒店門口接我哋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 si1 gei1 keoi5 wui5 hai2 zau2 dim3 mun4 hau2 zip3 ngo5 dei6
